switch-gaines-township.note: Same campus as MI GRR at 6100 East Paris Avenue, which is Switch's Pyramid campus. Covered by the Switch Grand Rapids record.

google-van-buren-township.note: Same campus as the Panattoni permit at Haggerty Road. Covered by the Google Van Buren Township record.

gibraltar-data-center-gibraltar.note: News report names 30 to 35 backup diesel generators for Raeden's proposed 100 MW data center. No permit or size was found, so capacity is blank.

project-mitten-saline.note: Permit version 2.0 and the application form were read. Electrical sizes sum to about 38.2 MW. Even shaft figures give about 40.4 MW. Under 50 MW.

alliance-cloud-services-dowagiac.note: Permit PTI0000052 lists 15 diesel generators of 2,000 kilowatts, 30 MW. The planned 40 MW of gas power has no named unit and is on the watch list.

hyperscale-data-dowagiac.note: Same facility as Alliance Cloud Services in Dowagiac. The older permits name no engines. The planned gas power is on the watch list under the Alliance entry.

dxc-technology-services-auburn-hills.note: Permit 11-11 lists three 1,745 kilowatt and one 2,000 kilowatt diesel generators, 7.235 MW.

fca-us-llc-auburn-hills.note: Permit 199-10A lists four 1,745 kilowatt generators and one 1,500 kilowatt generator, 8.48 MW.

sanhua-international-troy.note: Permits 112-17 and 75-11 for the Beaumont Information Technology Center at 1350 Stephenson Highway each describe one 1,500 kilowatt diesel generator. At most 1.5 MW, or 3.0 MW if they are two units.

123net-southfield.note: The application says five 2,000 kilowatt diesel engines at the Southfield data center, 10 MW. A small exempt 150 kilowatt generator is left out.

microsoft-gaines-township.note: Searched the state air permit portal, the harvest files and news. Microsoft has only asked to rezone land in Gaines Township. No air permit or generator count was found.

metrobloks-southfield.note: Searched the state air permit portal and news. The city approved the site plan for a 100 MW building. No generators or air permit were found.

corewell-health-bradford-grand-rapids.note: The permit on record covers no generators.

united-shore-financial-s-pontiac.note: The permit on record covers no generators.
